form.label: Platform cleanup — HMS lib cleanup & daily job
form.description: index=platform_engr_prod, cleanup, host=arlos3bat1*. Host short name via rex. "Today: all expected hosts" is OK only if every host in bat_lo–bat_hi has a Daily cleanup line with cleanup_day = today (not merely if one host finished). If needed broaden host_pat.

input.label: Host pattern (Splunk wildcards; FQDN e.g. *.arlocloud.com still matches arlos3bat1*)
Restart / maintenance search
input.default: (restart OR maintenance OR "scheduled maintenance" OR systemd)

input.label: User account CSV refresh (adjust to your log line)

panel.title: Today: all expected hosts completed? (yyyyMMdd in message vs bat range)

search.query: | makeresults | eval bat_end=$bat_hi$ + 1 | eval n=mvrange($bat_lo$, bat_end) | mvexpand n | eval expected_host="arlos3bat".n | fields expected_host | join type=left expected_host [ search index=$idx$ host=$host_pat$ $base_q$ "Daily cleanup" "has completed" earliest=$t.earliest$ latest=$t.latest$ | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "Daily cleanup of (?<cleanup_day>\d{8}) has completed" | eval today=strftime(now(), "%Y%m%d") | where cleanup_day=today | rex field=host "^(?<expected_host>arlos3bat\d+)" | where isnotnull(expected_host) | stats count as today_done by expected_host ] | fillnull value=0 today_done | eval gap=if(today_done<1,1,0) | stats sum(gap) as missing_hosts | eval status=if(missing_hosts>0, "MISSING — not every host completed for today", "OK — all expected hosts completed for today")
index=$idx$ host=$host_pat$ $base_q$ "Daily cleanup" "has completed" | stats count as total

panel.title: Distinct hosts (any cleanup log in range)

search.query: index=$idx$ host=$host_pat$ $base_q$ | rex field=host "^(?<host_short>arlos3bat\d+)" | eval host_short=coalesce(host_short, host) | stats dc(host_short) as hosts

panel.title: Missing hosts — expected arlos3bat{bat_lo–bat_hi} with zero cleanup events in this window

search.query: | makeresults | eval bat_end=$bat_hi$ + 1 | eval n=mvrange($bat_lo$, bat_end) | mvexpand n | eval expected_host="arlos3bat".n | fields expected_host | join type=left expected_host [ search index=$idx$ host=$host_pat$ $base_q$ earliest=$t.earliest$ latest=$t.latest$ | rex field=host "^(?<expected_host>arlos3bat\d+)" | where isnotnull(expected_host) | stats count as event_count by expected_host ] | fillnull value=0 event_count | where event_count<1 | stats count as missing_count

panel.title: Expected vs actual — all hosts in range (MISSING = no logs / UF / ACL)

search.query: | makeresults | eval bat_end=$bat_hi$ + 1 | eval n=mvrange($bat_lo$, bat_end) | mvexpand n | eval expected_host="arlos3bat".n | fields expected_host | join type=left expected_host [ search index=$idx$ host=$host_pat$ $base_q$ earliest=$t.earliest$ latest=$t.latest$ | rex field=host "^(?<expected_host>arlos3bat\d+)" | where isnotnull(expected_host) | stats count as event_count by expected_host ] | fillnull value=0 event_count | eval status=if(event_count<1, "MISSING", "ok") | table expected_host event_count status | sort expected_host

panel.title: Daily cleanup completions by date (from message)

search.query: index=$idx$ host=$host_pat$ $base_q$ "Daily cleanup" "has completed" | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "Daily cleanup of (?<cleanup_day>\d{8}) has completed" | where isnotnull(cleanup_day) | stats count by cleanup_day | sort cleanup_day

index=$idx$ host=$host_pat$ $base_q$ "Daily cleanup" "has completed" | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "Daily cleanup of (?<cleanup_day>\d{8}) has completed" | rex field=host "^(?<host_short>arlos3bat\d+)" | stats latest(_time) as last_seen latest(cleanup_day) as last_cleanup_day latest(host) as host_raw by host_short | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z") | sort host_short
index=$idx$ host=$host_pat$ $base_q$ "Running library cleanup for" | timechart span=1h count
index=$idx$ host=$host_pat$ $base_q$ "Daily cleanup" "has completed" | timechart span=1h count

panel.title: hmslibcleanup / cleanup — event count by host (ingestion coverage)

search.query: index=$idx$ host=$host_pat$ $base_q$ (hmslibcleanup OR "library cleanup" OR "Running library cleanup") | rex field=host "^(?<host_short>arlos3bat\d+)" | stats count by host_short | sort host_short

panel.title: Restart / maintenance — tune token maint_q + alert on this search

search.query: index=$idx$ host=$host_pat$ $maint_q$ | table _time host source _raw | sort - _time | head 100

panel.title: User account CSV refresh (set token csv_q to your log pattern)

search.query: index=$idx$ host=$host_pat$ $csv_q$ | rex field=host "^(?<host_short>arlos3bat\d+)" | stats latest(_time) as last_epoch latest(host) as host_raw by host_short | eval last_log=strftime(last_epoch, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z") | eval days_since=round((now()-last_epoch)/86400,1) | eval stale=if(days_since>7, "older than 7d", "within 7d") | sort host_short
index=$idx$ host=$host_pat$ $base_q$ | table _time host source _raw | sort - _time | head 150
